name: GetEmailsByFolder
description: Retrieves all email messages from a specified folder in a Microsoft 365 Outlook mailbox using Microsoft Graph API.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Outlook Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and access mailbox data through Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: MailboxAddress
fields.label: Mailbox Address
fields.description: Mailbox address containing the folder. Leave empty to use the authenticated user's mailbox.

fields.name: FolderId
fields.label: Folder ID
fields.description: The unique ID of the folder from which to retrieve emails.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the list of retrieved emails from the specified folder including metadata such as subject, sender, recipients, and body preview.
